issue_request: FHIR-16991 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core datatypes issue raised against STU3. It asked whether the JSON example for an extension on an integer element named count should use _count rather than count_, with the resolution to fix this everywhere it existed.
initial_application: The issue was applied by svn revision 14296, preserved in git as db75fc52f7adaa2ea681cd0cd72383bfe09fe523, which changed source/datatypes.html from "count_" to "_count". The current branch contains that commit.
additional_context: source/datatypes.html remains the current datatypes narrative source, and source/fhir.ini treats datatypes.html as the default datatype publication page unless a datatype is published elsewhere. FHIR-I minutes for 2018-07-09 corroborate that tracker item 16991 was accepted as Persuasive. No searched Zulip or Confluence evidence revealed a conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/datatypes.html already shows the id and extension data for the primitive count element in the sibling JSON property named _count, and no obsolete "count_" occurrence was found under source/.
